title: AI Project OS v1.4 and hotfix: GitHub Projects live provisioning complete
body:
AI Project OS v1.4 (GitHub Projects Live Provisioning Integration) is merged to main (`1623e7e`). The field-creation mutation hotfix (`deab61b` / `532eb66`) is also merged. Scripts are verified: `setup-apply` creates projects and provisions 13 custom fields; `import-issues` supports dry-run mode and three-layer duplicate detection. No live issue import has run yet.

## What is complete
- v1.4 merged: `1623e7e`
- Hotfix merged: `532eb66`
- GitHub Project container created: https://github.com/users/GHnol/projects/1
- Project node ID: `PVT_kwHOBuFnQM4BYzCh`
- 13/13 custom fields provisioned (TEXT, DATE, SINGLE_SELECT)
- `external-sync-map.local.json` populated locally with all field IDs (gitignored)
- No GitHub Issues imported; no Project items added; no field values set on items

## What remains
- Manual UI: Status field options and 14 views (see KM-PC-006)
- Source records authored and committed (KM-PC-003)
- First import dry-run (KM-PC-004)
- First import apply, Coordinator-approved (KM-PC-005)
success_criteria: v1.4 and hotfix merged to main; 13/13 custom fields live on Project #1; sync map populated locally

title: Author real GitHub Project source records for first import
body:
The example file (`github-projects-source-records.example.json`) contains illustrative placeholder records only. This task is to create `docs/project-control/github-projects-source-records.json` — the real first-import source file used for live issue creation.

## Scope
- Focus on current operating state: board completion, open decisions, actionable risks, and next package gate
- Keep to 8–15 records for the first import — prefer fewer, well-chosen records
- Follow `docs/project-control/github-projects-source-schema.md` exactly
- Validate JSON and run dry-run before committing
- Do not import every backlog item; do not start Package 5B

## Acceptance criteria
- File is valid JSON
- All required schema fields present per record
- All `os_id` values are unique and stable
- Dry-run produces no errors and no unintended records
success_criteria: github-projects-source-records.json written, JSON-valid, dry-run clean, Coordinator approves commit

title: Run first GitHub Issues import dry-run against real source records
body:
Before applying any live import, run the import script in dry-run mode against the real source records file to validate all records parse correctly, confirm planned Issue titles, detect any schema errors, and verify zero duplicates are expected.

## Command
```bash
node scripts/github-project-import-issues.mjs \
  --input docs/project-control/github-projects-source-records.json \
  --owner GHnol --repo MessageVault \
  --project-number 1 \
  --project-title "KeepMees Project Control" \
  --sync-map docs/project-control/external-sync-map.local.json
```

## Expected output
- All records load without parse errors
- 0 duplicates detected (no prior import run)
- Planned Issue list matches source record count and titles
- No external writes performed

## Pre-conditions
- `github-projects-source-records.json` committed and clean (KM-PC-003 done)
- `external-sync-map.local.json` present locally (retains field IDs from setup-apply)
success_criteria: Dry-run shows all records valid; no errors; no duplicates; no writes performed

```bash
  --input docs/project-control/github-projects-source-records.json \
  --owner GHnol --repo MessageVault \
  --project-number 1 \
  --project-title "KeepMees Project Control" \
  --sync-map docs/project-control/external-sync-map.local.json
```

## Post-apply verification
- Confirm Issues created in GHnol/MessageVault repo
- Confirm items appear in Project #1
- Confirm all custom field values are set correctly
- `external-sync-map.local.json` updated with issue numbers and item node IDs (remains gitignored — do not commit)
success_criteria: Issues created for all source records; items added to Project #1; all custom field values set; sync map updated locally

title: Risk: duplicate GitHub Issues or Project items during first import
body:
The import script uses three-layer duplicate detection (sync map lookup, title-match search, OS ID label search). However, the first import has not yet run and the dedup logic has not been exercised against a live repo with real Issues.

## Risk description
- If the import script runs more than once without a current sync map, it may create duplicate Issues
- The sync map (`external-sync-map.local.json`) is gitignored — if lost between sessions, Layer 1 dedup is unavailable and only Layers 2/3 protect against duplicates
- Layer 2 (title match) and Layer 3 (OS ID label) add API latency and may miss edge cases

## Mitigation (in place)
- Always run dry-run before apply — confirms planned record count
- Confirm sync map exists locally before running any apply
- Three-layer dedup is implemented in `github-project-import-issues.mjs`
- Gitignore protection verified on every apply run

## Status
Open — no import has run yet. Monitor during first import apply (`KM-PC-005`).
success_criteria: First import completes with 0 duplicate Issues; sync map updated and retained locally after apply

title: Risk: accidental commit of external-sync-map.local.json
body:
The local sync map (`docs/project-control/external-sync-map.local.json`) contains GitHub Project item node IDs, Issue node IDs, and field IDs. It must never be committed to the repo — it holds local external state, not repo truth.

## Risk description
- A `git add .` or broad staging command could accidentally stage the sync map
- Future `.gitignore` edits could remove the protection without noticing
- Any committed sync map entry would expose external IDs in git history

## Mitigation (already in place)
- `docs/project-control/external-sync-map.local.json` is gitignored (`.gitignore:64`)
- All apply scripts verify gitignore before writing the sync map
- Agents are instructed by AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md never to stage or commit this file

## Status
Mitigated — gitignore protection active and verified. Monitor whenever `.gitignore` is edited.
success_criteria: external-sync-map.local.json never appears in git status; gitignore check passes on every apply run

title: Decision: create AI Project OS Template GitHub Project for future repos
body:
The KeepMees GitHub Projects automation layer (scripts, schema, sync map, runbook) is now functional. A future decision is whether to establish a reusable GitHub Project template that other repos can copy via the `--from-template` path in `github-project-setup-apply.mjs`.

## Context
- `github-project-setup-apply.mjs` already supports `--from-template --template-project-number N`
- The `copyProjectV2` GraphQL mutation is implemented and tested
- The KeepMees Project #1 could serve as a template once the board is fully configured
- The Puzzle project already has a manually set-up GitHub Project (separate context)

## Decision options
1. Designate KeepMees Project #1 as the OS template after board is operational
2. Create a dedicated separate template project for the AI Project OS layer
3. Defer until a second repo actively needs GitHub Projects automation
4. Skip template approach; each repo gets a fresh `setup-apply` run

## Timing
Not urgent. Defer until KeepMees board is fully operational and at least one other repo needs GitHub Projects.
success_criteria: Decision recorded when a second repo requires GitHub Projects; template created or approach confirmed
